name: Exp_XD-RangeSwitch
summary: This EA trades based on the XD-RangeSwitch custom indicator, which identifies range breakouts by detecting peaks. It opens buy/sell positions when breakout signals appear and closes positions on opposite signals or trend reversals, with configurable trade direction (with or against the signal).
summary_zh: 该EA基于XD-RangeSwitch自定义指标进行交易，通过检测峰值来识别区间突破。当突破信号出现时开仓做多或做空，在反向信号或趋势反转时平仓，支持顺势或逆势交易模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XD-RangeSwitch指标检测价格区间的突破信号进行交易。入场条件：当指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 2或3）出现非空值时触发买入信号，当下行信号缓冲区出现非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：当检测到趋势缓冲区（buffer 0或1）出现反向趋势值时平仓，即多头趋势消失时平多，空头趋势消失时平空。仓位管理采用固定手数或按存款比例计算手数（通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制），支持LOT和百分比两种模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用存款的比例（默认0.1），配合止损和止盈设置进行风险控制。策略还提供了逆势交易模式（FalshDirect），可以将指标的上下信号互换执行，实现反向交易逻辑。新K线检测机制确保信号仅在K线确认后触发，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the XD-RangeSwitch indicator which detects price range breakout signals for trading. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the upward signal buffer (buffer 2 or 3) shows a non-empty value, and a sell signal is triggered when the downward signal buffer shows a non-empty value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when the trend buffer (buffer 0 or 1) shows a reversal, meaning long positions close when the uptrend disappears and short positions close when the downtrend disappears. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or deposit-percentage-based calculation controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting LOT and percentage modes. Money management controls the share of deposit per trade through the MM parameter (default 0.1), combined with configurable stop loss and take profit settings for risk control. The strategy also provides a counter-signal trading mode (FalshDirect) that swaps the indicator's up/down signals for reverse trading logic. A new bar detection mechanism ensures signals are only triggered after bar confirmation, preventing duplicate trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易占用存款比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方式（固定手数或按比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (fixed lot or proportional)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏离点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 支持顺势和逆势两种交易模式，灵活适应不同市场环境
具有完整的止损止盈设置，风险可控
新K线检测机制避免同一信号重复交易
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活配置只做多或只做空
包含数据重算机制（Recount），在数据不足时自动等待重试
pros_en: Supports both with-signal and against-signal trading modes for flexibility in different market conditions
Complete stop loss and take profit settings for controlled risk
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same signal
Independent buy/sell permission switches allow flexible long-only or short-only configuration
Includes a recount mechanism that automatically retries when data is insufficient
cons: 依赖自定义指标XD-RangeSwitch，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点止盈2000点设置偏大，可能不适用于所有品种
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能重复开仓
逆势交易模式（FalshDirect）可能增加风险但缺少额外风控
cons_en: Depends on the custom XD-RangeSwitch indicator; EA fails to run if the indicator file is missing
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Stop loss 1000 and take profit 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments
No position check logic before opening, potentially leading to duplicate positions
Counter-signal mode (FalshDirect) may increase risk without additional risk controls
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，在开仓前确认无同方向持仓，避免重复开仓
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数限制，提高交易安全性
improvements_en: Add position check logic before opening to confirm no existing same-direction positions, preventing duplicates
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to improve trading safety

risk_points: 缺少开仓前持仓检查，可能导致重复开仓造成过度敞口
逆势交易模式在趋势延续时可能持续亏损
risk_points_en: No position check before opening, potentially causing duplicate positions and excessive exposure
Counter-signal trading mode may sustain losses when trends persist
